title: Xi Gains Leverage Before Trump Summit After Tariff Reversal
title_zh: 关税逆转后习近平在特朗普峰会前获得影响力
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping is heading to the negotiating table with Donald Trump with a boost in bargaining power, after the US leader lost his ability to quickly raise tariffs for nearly any reason.
summary_zh: 在美国领导人因几乎任何原因失去快速提高关税的能力后，中国国家主席习近平正与唐纳德·特朗普一起走上谈判桌，讨价还价能力得到增强。

title: SK Hynix Boss Pledges to Boost Output of AI Memory Chips
title_zh: SK海力士老板承诺提高AI存储芯片产量
summary: The chipmaker’s share price has more than quadrupled over the past year on record earnings.
summary_zh: 这家芯片制造商的股价在过去一年里上涨了四倍多，盈利创历史新高。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slip amid Trump tariff fallout, with Iran-US talks on deck
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货因特朗普关税影响而下滑，伊朗与美国谈判即将进行
summary: Wall Street has been buffeted by the winds of Trump's tariffs over the weekend. A SCOTUS ruling was quickly refuted by the president in a fast-developing situation.
summary_zh: 周末，华尔街受到特朗普关税之风的打击。在形势迅速发展的情况下，最高法院的一项裁决很快就被总统驳斥。

title: ‘Money's moving out of tech’: Wall Street weighs stock market winners amid the AI scare trade
title_zh: “资金正在从科技领域转移”：华尔街在人工智能恐慌交易中权衡股市赢家
summary: Investors are rotating out of the most popular tech stocks. Here's where they are finding gains.
summary_zh: 投资者正在从最受欢迎的科技股中撤出。这就是他们发现收益的地方。

title: Here's Walmart's $1 trillion secret
title_zh: 这是沃尔玛 1 万亿美元的秘密
summary: Walmart remains no joke on tech.
summary_zh: 沃尔玛在科技方面始终不开玩笑。

title: Nvidia is moving in on Intel and AMD's home turf
title_zh: Nvidia 正在进军英特尔和 AMD 的主场
summary: Nvidia is getting into the CPU server market, and that could be trouble for Intel and AMD.
summary_zh: Nvidia 正在进军 CPU 服务器市场，这可能会给英特尔和 AMD 带来麻烦。

title: Tesla: As institutional investors sell stock, retail investors pile in
title_zh: 特斯拉：随着机构投资者抛售股票，散户投资者纷纷涌入
summary: Call it the latest tug-of-war between Tesla bulls and bears. But this time, it's institutional versus retail investors.
summary_zh: 这可以称为特斯拉多头和空头之间的最新拉锯战。但这一次，是机构投资者与散户投资者的较量。
